programme.title: Sangu Chakkaram
programme.desc: When a few children go to play at an abandoned mansion, they are soon joined by adults with evil intentions. However, a mother-daughter duo of ghosts will not let anybody out of the house.

programme.title: Appu
programme.desc: Taxi driver Appu is haunted by his past when his sister was killed by a eunuch who was also a powerful pimp. While trying to find him, he comes across another girl who is about to meet the same fate.

programme.title: Yaaradi Nee Mohini
programme.desc: Vasu falls in love with Keerthi at first sight. However, she rejects his advances and reveals that her marriage has been arranged with her uncle's son, who turns out to be Vasu's best friend.

programme.title: Oram Po
programme.desc: Chandru races his autorickshaw for sport while his friend Bigilu acts as his mechanic. However, tragedy strikes when he begins to date Bigilu's niece while simultaneously challenging a rival racer.

programme.title: Enga Veetu Ramayanam
programme.desc: Paramasivam and Parvathy are looking for suitable brides for their sons. However, they face various obstacles during their search.

programme.title: Ore Raththam
programme.desc: Mahesh is an educated young man whose father is an extremely orthodox person and a strong believer of the caste system. Kamakshi, his sister, bears a child from her lover and tries to hide the truth.

programme.title: Maruthu Paandi
